basic_details.job_title: IIT Hyderabad Research Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026 has one contract post of Research Associate – I (1 vacancy) for one year, at the Centre of Excellence on Clean Coal Energy and Net Zero (CLEANZ), Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad. The post serves the project "Coal-ash based self-cleaning Bricks/Tiles for, non-load bearing tiles, and cladding applications". It pays ₹58,000 per month + 30% HRA (as per DST norms). Candidates with a Ph.D. in Civil Engineering, Materials Science, or Packaging Technology can apply through a Google Form by 5:00 PM on 7 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Apply through the Google Form given in the notice (https://forms.gle/quBr1FvY2SQV8iR86) by 5:00 PM on 7 November 2026. The notice does not describe any other way to apply.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Hyderabad
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located at Kandi, Telangana - 502285. The Centre of Excellence on Clean Coal Energy and Net Zero (CLEANZ) at IIT Hyderabad is running the project this post serves. The project is led by Principal Investigator Prof. Atul Suresh Deshpande, Professor, Department of Materials Science and Metallurgical Engineering, IIT Hyderabad.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The desirable experience is not a condition for applying. It is listed as a preference. The notice invites "motivated and eligible candidates". rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. in Civil Engineering, Materials Science, or Packaging Technology
rows.desirable_experience: Experience in fabrication of ceramic/polymer composites and concrete, mechanical testing and material characterization

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Emoluments: ₹58,000 per month + 30% HRA (as per DST norms). The notice calls it a time-bound research associate position. The appointment will be purely on a contract basis for one year. The appointment may be extended based on the candidate's performance. Tentative joining date: 1 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Hyderabad Research Associate – I
content_sections.text: Apply through the Google Form given in the notice (https://forms.gle/quBr1FvY2SQV8iR86) by 5:00 PM on 7 November 2026. The notice does not describe any other way to apply.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection happens in two stages: resume shortlisting, then an online interview. Resume shortlisting: Applications are shortlisted on the basis of the resume. Online interview: Shortlisted candidates take an online interview. According to the notice, selection is based on research profile and interview performance. The notice does not give a date for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026 for Research Associate – I?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for Research Associate – I at the Centre of Excellence on Clean Coal Energy and Net Zero (CLEANZ), IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Research Associate – I post?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through the Google Form by 5:00 PM on 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for IIT Hyderabad Research Associate – I?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Ph.D. in Civil Engineering, Materials Science, or Packaging Technology. Experience in fabrication of ceramic/polymer composites and concrete, mechanical testing and material characterization is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of IIT Hyderabad Research Associate – I?
faq.answer: The emoluments are ₹58,000 per month + 30% HRA (as per DST norms).

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the monthly pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the emoluments as ₹58,000 per month + 30% HRA, as per DST norms.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IIT Hyderabad Research Associate – I post?
faq.answer: Fill in the Google Form at https://forms.gle/quBr1FvY2SQV8iR86 before 5:00 PM on 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIT Hyderabad Research Associate – I?
faq.answer: Selection is by resume shortlisting followed by an online interview. It is based on research profile and interview performance.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIT Hyderabad Research Associate – I post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on a contract basis for one year. It may be extended based on the candidate's performance.

faq.question: Q9. When will the selected candidate join?
faq.answer: The tentative joining date in the notice is 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Which project is the IIT Hyderabad Research Associate – I hired for?
faq.answer: The post is for the project "Coal-ash based self-cleaning Bricks/Tiles for, non-load bearing tiles, and cladding applications". The project is at CLEANZ, IIT Hyderabad, under Principal Investigator Prof. Atul Suresh Deshpande.
